I will kill you then.|Musters warns Erso that she plans to kill her|[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]]}} '''Oolin Musters''', known as '''Kennel''' while imprisoned by the [[Galactic Empire]] despite identifying herself to others as '''Nail''', was a [[Blutopian]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By [[1 BBY]], Musters had been captured by the Empire and imprisoned in a [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|labor camp]] on the [[planet]] [[Wobani]] where she shared a cell with the criminal [[Jyn Erso]]. Musters threatened to [[Death|kill]] Erso, but never got the chance, as her cellmate was [[Liberation of Erso|rescued]] by [[Extraction Team Bravo|Rebel soldiers]] working for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. ==Biography== {{Quote|Who's going to keep you company?''"
"''I like a quiet cell.''"
"''What if I kill you first?''"
"''Then I hope you like a quiet cell, Liana Hallik.|Erso teases Musters about her threat to kill her|}} [[File:Musters_and_Jyn.png|thumb|left|280px|Oolin Musters shared a cell with Jyn Erso on Wobani.]] Oolin Musters was a [[Blutopian]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was captured by the [[Galactic Empire]] and imprisoned in a [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|Imperial labor camp]] on the [[planet]] [[Wobani]]. While in the camp she identified herself to other prisoners as Nail, but instead earned the nickname Kennel, as she hosted various [[parasite]]s within a filthy [[Clothing|cloth jacket]] that she used to half cover her chest. The [[human]] criminal [[Jyn Erso]] was assigned as Musters' cellmate under the false name "Liana Hallik," and late one night in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Wobani]] in the [[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] to [[1 BBY]]. when Erso woke Musters from [[sleep]] by sitting up in her bunk, the alien warned the human that on their next work assignment together she would [[Death|kill]] her. The following [[Standard day|day]], the pair were randomly selected by the guards for the day's work shift and removed from their cell to be chained into a [[HCVw A9 turbo tank|turbo-tank]] used by the camp as a prisoner transport. The alien did not make [[eye]] contact with any of the other three prisoners that were accompanying them, which Erso took to mean that Musters would have no allies in her attempt on her life. [[File:Musters_explosion.png|thumb|right|280px|The turbo-tank carrying Musters and Erso was attacked by the Rebel Alliance.]] Musters never had a chance to attempt to kill Erso however, as before the [[tank]] reached its destination it was [[Liberation of Erso|attacked]] by a [[Extraction Team Bravo|squad]] of Alliance [[Special forces]] troopers who were searching for Erso. The rebels quickly blew the door off the vehicle, shocking Musters, and killed the three [[stormtrooper]]s guarding the prisoners. They then freed their target, who hit Rebel [[Sergeant]] [[Ruescott Melshi]] with a spade and promptly tried to escape from her saviors, fleeing past Musters as the alien stood up. Erso made it out of the tank before being stopped by the reprogrammed [[KX-series security droid]] [[K-2SO]]. Erso was then taken back to the Alliance's [[Great Temple|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. Musters was then able to escape from Imperial custody as well and made her way to [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. While in one of the [[city]]'s streets she and other civilians had to stand aside to allow an Imperial patrol including a [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank|"Occupier" combat assault tank]]''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' to pass by. As the patrol moved past Musters, it was attacked by members of the rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[partisans]], causing most civilians in the street to flee. Shortly after this attack, Jedha city was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Were you always like this? Before Wobani? Back to when you were a kid?''"
"''Yes.''"
"''Me, too.|Erso questions Musters about her personality|}} [[File:OolinMusters-CGSWG.png|thumb|200px|left|Musters had leathery gray and brown skin.]] Oolin Musters had [[leather]]y [[Color|gray]] and brown skin and tentacles protruding from her pinched, [[worm]]-like faces. Musters moaned and wheezed while she slept, and while awake spoke with a voice that sounded like claws on a slate. When Erso woke late at night causing Musters to also wake, the alien told her cellmate to go back to sleep and then asked her if she wanted a warning before she was killed. Despite Erso claiming she did not want a warning, Musters informed her of her plans for murder anyway, claiming that she liked a quiet cell when Erso pointed out that the alien would miss her company. When Erso asked why, Musters claimed that she had always been the way she was while imprisoned, even as a child. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Musters_on_Set.png|thumb|right|250px|Shah walking around in Musters' costume on the set of Jedha]] Oolin Musters was first shown briefly in the second trailer revealed for the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', which was released on [[October 13]], [[2016]] prior to the film's release in North America on [[December 16]] later that year.{{SWYouTube|sC9abcLLQpI|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Trailer #2 (Official)|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-trailer-2}} The character was portrayed by actor [[Kiran Shah]],{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-talking-rogue-one-aliens-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: Talking ''Rogue One'' Aliens with Pablo Hidalgo}} who had previously portrayed characters in the films [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].{{SW|url=andor-s1-e2-trivia-gallery|text="That Would Be Me" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} The character's name was also released prior to the film as part of an article titled "Star Wars: Meet the Creatures and Droids in Rogue One" published in a [[Entertainment Weekly's Ultimate Guide to Rogue One|special issue]] of [[Entertainment Weekly Books|''Entertainment Weekly'']] released on [[December 9]]. In the article, creature-effects supervisor [[Neal Scanlan]] revealed that Musters' design was inspired by real-life sea creatures such as squid, and referred to the character as a "he."''[[Entertainment Weekly's Ultimate Guide to Rogue One]]'' Musters was originally designed to be a pedestrian in the streets of Jedha City. Her production nickname was "Blue Top." ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Oolin Musters}} *''[[Rebel Rising]]'' {{Ab|Rebel Rising (audiobook)}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Nail and Kennel}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 1|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|sC9abcLLQpI|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Trailer #2 (Official)|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-trailer-2}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|P2N0Mn4i4Dw|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story "Creature Featurette"|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-creature-featurette}} *''[[Entertainment Weekly's Ultimate Guide to Rogue One]]'' {{1stID|Oolin Musters}} *{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-talking-rogue-one-aliens-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: Talking ''Rogue One'' Aliens with Pablo Hidalgo}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|62|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Oolin Musters|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11644229}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *[[Star Wars Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2023|''Star Wars'' Day-at-a-Time Calendar 2023]] *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|nail|Nail}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Oolin Musters#kanon |fr=Oolin Musters |ja=オーリン・マスタース |ka=ულინ მასტერსი |nl=Oolin Musters |pl=Oolin Musters }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Musters, Oolin}} [[Category:Alliance to Restore the Republic members]] [[Category:Blutopians]] [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]]
